_aciklama: Görev K18: sihirbazdaki kısa açıklamalar (yalnızca Builder parçası yükler, ana parçaya girmez). features: sınıf özelliklerinin tek cümlelik özeti, anahtar `sınıf:özellik` (tr elle, SRD 5.2.1 metninden; en SRD metninin ilk cümlesi). Alt sınıf özelliklerinin özeti data/subclasses.json description alanından. mastery ve properties: Weapon Mastery ve silah özellikleri (SRD 5.2.1).

tr.barbarian:rage: Bonus eylemle öfkelen: fiziksel hasara direnç, STR saldırılarına ek hasar, STR testlerinde avantaj.
tr.barbarian:unarmored-defense: Zırhsızken AC = 10 + DEX + sınıfın ek yetenek değiştiricisi.
tr.barbarian:weapon-mastery: Seçtiğin silahların ustalık özelliğini (Cleave, Vex…) kullanırsın.
tr.barbarian:danger-sense: Görebildiğin etkilere karşı DEX kurtarma zarlarında avantajın olur.
tr.barbarian:reckless-attack: Turunun ilk saldırısında STR saldırılarına avantaj alırsın, sana yapılan saldırılar da avantajlı olur.
tr.barbarian:primal-knowledge: Ek bir beceri; öfkeliyken bazı beceri testlerinde STR kullanabilirsin.
tr.barbarian:extra-attack: Attack eyleminde bir yerine iki saldırı yaparsın.
tr.barbarian:fast-movement: Ağır zırh giymiyorken hızın 10 ft artar.
tr.barbarian:instinctive-pounce: Öfkeye girerken hızının yarısı kadar hareket edebilirsin.
tr.barbarian:brutal-strike: Reckless Attack yaparken avantajdan vazgeçip vurduğunda ek hasar ve bir etki (itme, yavaşlatma) verirsin.
tr.barbarian:relentless-rage: Öfkeliyken 0 HP'ye düşünce CON kurtarma zarıyla ayakta kalabilirsin.
tr.barbarian:persistent-rage: Öfken yalnızca bilinçsiz kalınca ya da sen bitirince sona erer; inisiyatifte öfke kullanımın dolar.
tr.barbarian:indomitable-might: STR testlerinde sonuç en az STR skorun olur.
tr.barbarian:primal-champion: STR ve CON skorların 4 artar (en çok 25).
tr.bard:bardic-inspiration: Bonus eylemle bir dosta ilham zarı verirsin; başarısız bir d20 testine ekleyebilir.
tr.bard:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.bard:expertise: Seçtiğin becerilerde yetkinlik bonusun iki kat sayılır.
tr.bard:jack-of-all-trades: Yetkin olmadığın beceri testlerine yetkinlik bonusunun yarısını eklersin.
tr.bard:font-of-inspiration: Kısa dinlenmede ilham zarların dolar; büyü yuvası harcayarak da ilham verebilirsin.
tr.bard:countercharm: Charmed ya da Frightened'a karşı başarısız kurtarma zarını tepkiyle yeniden attırırsın.
tr.bard:magical-secrets: Bard, Cleric, Druid ve Wizard listelerinden büyü hazırlayabilirsin.
tr.bard:superior-inspiration: İnisiyatifte ilham zarın en az ikiye tamamlanır.
tr.bard:words-of-creation: Power Word Heal ve Power Word Kill her zaman hazır; ikinci bir hedefe de uygulanabilir.
tr.cleric:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.cleric:divine-order: Rol seç: Protector (ağır zırh, Martial silah) ya da Thaumaturge (ek cantrip, Arcana/Religion bonusu).
tr.cleric:channel-divinity: Kısa dinlenmede dolan kullanımlarla Divine Spark (iyileştir ya da hasar) ve Turn Undead yaparsın.
tr.cleric:sear-undead: Turn Undead başarısız olan ölümsüzlere Radiant hasar da verir.
tr.cleric:blessed-strikes: Turda bir silah ya da cantrip isabetine 1d8 ek hasar (Divine Strike) ya da cantrip'e WIS ekle (Potent Spellcasting).
tr.cleric:divine-intervention: Uzun dinlenmede bir kez, 5. seviyeye kadar bir Cleric büyüsünü slotsuz yaparsın.
tr.cleric:improved-blessed-strikes: Blessed Strikes güçlenir (2d8 ya da geçici HP).
tr.druid:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.druid:druidic: Druidçe bilirsin; Speak with Animals her zaman hazır.
tr.druid:primal-order: Rol seç: Warden (Medium zırh, Martial silah) ya da Magician (ek cantrip, Arcana/Nature bonusu).
tr.druid:wild-shape: Bonus eylemle bildiğin bir hayvan biçimine girersin: seviyen kadar geçici HP, biçimin AC'si, hızı ve saldırıları.
tr.druid:wild-companion: Wild Shape kullanımı ya da slot harcayarak Find Familiar yaparsın.
tr.druid:wild-resurgence: Wild Shape kullanımın yoksa slot harcayarak bir kullanım kazanırsın; ya da kullanımla 1. seviye slot.
tr.druid:elemental-fury: Seç: turda bir isabete 1d8 element hasarı (Primal Strike) ya da Druid cantrip'lerine WIS hasarı (Potent Spellcasting).
tr.druid:improved-elemental-fury: Elemental Fury güçlenir (2d8 ya da cantrip menzili artar).
tr.druid:beast-spells: Wild Shape biçimindeyken de büyü yapabilirsin.
tr.druid:archdruid: İnisiyatifte Wild Shape kullanımın yoksa bir kullanım kazanırsın; ömrün yavaşlar.
tr.fighter:fighting-style: Bir savaş stili feat'i seçersin (Archery, Defense…).
tr.fighter:second-wind: Bonus eylemle 1d10 + Fighter seviyesi kadar HP kazanırsın.
tr.fighter:weapon-mastery: Seçtiğin silahların ustalık özelliğini (Cleave, Vex…) kullanırsın.
tr.fighter:action-surge: Turunda bir ek eylem kazanırsın (büyü eylemi değil); kısa dinlenmede dolar.
tr.fighter:tactical-mind: Başarısız bir yetenek testine Second Wind harcayıp 1d10 eklersin.
tr.fighter:extra-attack: Attack eyleminde bir yerine iki saldırı yaparsın.
tr.fighter:tactical-shift: Second Wind kullanınca fırsat saldırısı almadan hızının yarısı kadar hareket edersin.
tr.fighter:indomitable: Başarısız bir kurtarma zarını Fighter seviyeni ekleyerek yeniden atarsın.
tr.fighter:tactical-master: Saldırıda silahın ustalığını Push, Sap ya da Slow ile değiştirebilirsin.
tr.fighter:studied-attacks: Iskaladığın hedefe sonraki saldırında avantajın olur.
tr.monk:martial-arts: Zırhsız ve kalkansızken Monk silahı ve silahsız vuruşla DEX ve Martial Arts zarı; bonus eylemle bir vuruş.
tr.monk:unarmored-defense: Zırhsız ve kalkansızken AC = 10 + DEX + WIS.
tr.monk:monks-focus: Focus puanlarıyla Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense ve Step of the Wind yaparsın.
tr.monk:uncanny-metabolism: İnisiyatifte bir kez Focus puanların dolar ve Martial Arts zarı kadar iyileşirsin.
tr.monk:deflect-attacks: Tepkiyle seni vuran saldırının hasarını azaltırsın; sıfırlarsan saldırıyı geri yöneltebilirsin.
tr.monk:slow-fall: Tepkiyle düşme hasarını Monk seviyenin beş katı kadar azaltırsın.
tr.monk:extra-attack: Attack eyleminde bir yerine iki saldırı yaparsın.
tr.monk:stunning-strike: Monk silahı ya da silahsız isabette 1 Focus ile hedefi CON kurtarma zarıyla Stunned yaparsın.
tr.monk:evasion: DEX kurtarma zarında başarıda hasar almazsın, başarısızlıkta yarısını alırsın.
tr.monk:acrobatic-movement: Zırhsızken dikey yüzeylerde ve sıvı üstünde yürüyebilirsin.
tr.monk:heightened-focus: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense ve Step of the Wind güçlenir.
tr.monk:self-restoration: Tur sonunda Charmed, Frightened ya da Poisoned durumundan kurtulursun.
tr.monk:deflect-energy: Deflect Attacks her hasar türüne karşı çalışır.
tr.monk:disciplined-survivor: Bütün kurtarma zarlarında yetkinsin; başarısız zarı Focus ile yeniden atarsın.
tr.monk:superior-defense: Focus harcayarak bir dakika Force dışı hasarlara direnç kazanırsın.
tr.monk:body-and-mind: DEX ve WIS skorların 4 artar (en çok 25).
tr.paladin:lay-on-hands: Dokunarak iyileştirme havuzundan HP verir ya da Poisoned'ı kaldırırsın.
tr.paladin:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.paladin:weapon-mastery: Seçtiğin silahların ustalık özelliğini (Cleave, Vex…) kullanırsın.
tr.paladin:fighting-style: Bir savaş stili feat'i seçersin (Archery, Defense…).
tr.paladin:paladins-smite: Divine Smite her zaman hazır; uzun dinlenmede bir kez slotsuz yaparsın.
tr.paladin:channel-divinity: Kısa dinlenmede dolan kullanımlarla Divine Sense ve yeminine ait güçleri kullanırsın.
tr.paladin:extra-attack: Attack eyleminde bir yerine iki saldırı yaparsın.
tr.paladin:faithful-steed: Find Steed her zaman hazır; uzun dinlenmede bir kez slotsuz yaparsın.
tr.paladin:aura-of-protection: Sen ve 10 ft içindeki dostların kurtarma zarlarına CHA değiştiricini eklersiniz.
tr.paladin:abjure-foes: Channel Divinity ile birkaç düşmanı WIS kurtarma zarıyla Frightened yaparsın.
tr.paladin:aura-of-courage: Sen ve auradaki dostların Frightened olamazsınız.
tr.paladin:radiant-strikes: Yakın dövüş silah isabetlerin 1d8 ek Radiant hasar verir.
tr.paladin:restoring-touch: Lay On Hands ile bazı durumları da (Blinded, Charmed…) kaldırırsın.
tr.ranger:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.ranger:favored-enemy: Hunter's Mark her zaman hazır; birkaç kez slotsuz yaparsın.
tr.ranger:weapon-mastery: Seçtiğin silahların ustalık özelliğini (Cleave, Vex…) kullanırsın.
tr.ranger:deft-explorer: Bir becerinde uzmanlık ve iki ek dil kazanırsın.
tr.ranger:fighting-style: Bir savaş stili feat'i seçersin (Archery, Defense…).
tr.ranger:extra-attack: Attack eyleminde bir yerine iki saldırı yaparsın.
tr.ranger:roving: Ağır zırh giymiyorken hızın artar; tırmanma ve yüzme hızın olur.
tr.ranger:expertise: Seçtiğin becerilerde yetkinlik bonusun iki kat sayılır.
tr.ranger:tireless: Eylemle geçici HP kazanırsın; kısa dinlenmede Exhaustion azalır.
tr.ranger:relentless-hunter: Hunter's Mark hasar alınca konsantrasyonun bozulmaz.
tr.ranger:natures-veil: Bonus eylemle bir sonraki turunun sonuna kadar Invisible olursun.
tr.ranger:precise-hunter: Hunter's Mark'lı hedefe saldırılarında avantajın olur.
tr.ranger:foe-slayer: Hunter's Mark'ın hasar zarı d10 olur.
tr.rogue:expertise: Seçtiğin becerilerde yetkinlik bonusun iki kat sayılır.
tr.rogue:sneak-attack: Turda bir kez avantajlı ya da yanında dostun olan hedefe Finesse/menzilli isabette ek hasar.
tr.rogue:thieves-cant: Hırsızların gizli dilini ve bir ek dili bilirsin.
tr.rogue:weapon-mastery: Seçtiğin silahların ustalık özelliğini (Cleave, Vex…) kullanırsın.
tr.rogue:cunning-action: Bonus eylemle Dash, Disengage ya da Hide yaparsın.
tr.rogue:steady-aim: Bu tur hareket etmediysen bonus eylemle sonraki saldırına avantaj alırsın.
tr.rogue:cunning-strike: Sneak Attack zarlarından vazgeçip hedefe bir etki (Poison, Trip, Withdraw) uygularsın.
tr.rogue:uncanny-dodge: Tepkiyle seni vuran saldırının hasarını yarıya indirirsin.
tr.rogue:evasion: DEX kurtarma zarında başarıda hasar almazsın, başarısızlıkta yarısını alırsın.
tr.rogue:reliable-talent: Yetkin olduğun yetenek testlerinde 9 ve altı atış 10 sayılır.
tr.rogue:improved-cunning-strike: Bir Sneak Attack'ta iki Cunning Strike etkisi kullanabilirsin.
tr.rogue:devious-strikes: Cunning Strike'a Daze, Knock Out ve Obscure etkileri eklenir.
tr.rogue:slippery-mind: WIS ve CHA kurtarma zarlarında yetkinsin.
tr.rogue:elusive: Incapacitated değilken sana yapılan saldırılar avantajlı olamaz.
tr.rogue:stroke-of-luck: Başarısız bir d20 testini 20 sayarsın; kısa dinlenmede dolar.
tr.sorcerer:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.sorcerer:innate-sorcery: Bonus eylemle bir dakika büyü DC'n 1 artar ve Sorcerer büyü saldırılarında avantajın olur.
tr.sorcerer:font-of-magic: Sorcery Point ile büyü yuvası yaratır ya da yuvayı puana çevirirsin.
tr.sorcerer:metamagic: Sorcery Point harcayıp büyülerini değiştirirsin (Quickened, Twinned…).
tr.sorcerer:sorcerous-restoration: Kısa dinlenmede bir kez Sorcery Point'lerinin bir kısmını geri kazanırsın.
tr.sorcerer:sorcery-incarnate: Innate Sorcery kullanımın yoksa Sorcery Point ile açarsın; açıkken bir büyüye iki Metamagic.
tr.sorcerer:arcane-apotheosis: Innate Sorcery açıkken turda bir Metamagic'i puansız kullanırsın.
tr.warlock:eldritch-invocations: Eldritch Blast'i güçlendiren ya da yeni yetenekler veren Invocation'lar seçersin.
tr.warlock:pact-magic: Az sayıda ama en yüksek seviyeli büyü yuvan var; kısa dinlenmede dolar.
tr.warlock:magical-cunning: Bir dakikalık ayinle Pact Magic yuvalarının yarısını geri kazanırsın.
tr.warlock:contact-patron: Contact Other Plane her zaman hazır; uzun dinlenmede bir kez slotsuz ve başarılı.
tr.warlock:mystic-arcanum: Yüksek seviyeli bir Warlock büyüsünü uzun dinlenmede bir kez slotsuz yaparsın.
tr.warlock:eldritch-master: Magical Cunning bütün Pact Magic yuvalarını geri getirir.
tr.wizard:spellcasting: Sınıfının listesinden büyü hazırlar ve büyü yuvalarıyla yaparsın.
tr.wizard:ritual-adept: Büyü kitabındaki ritüel büyüleri hazırlamadan ritüel olarak yaparsın.
tr.wizard:arcane-recovery: Kısa dinlenmede bir kez, toplam seviyesi Wizard seviyenin yarısı kadar yuva geri kazanırsın.
tr.wizard:scholar: Bir bilgi becerisinde (Arcana, History…) uzmanlık kazanırsın.
tr.wizard:memorize-spell: Kısa dinlenmede hazırladığın bir büyüyü kitabındaki başka biriyle değiştirirsin.
tr.wizard:spell-mastery: Seçtiğin bir 1. ve bir 2. seviye büyüyü en düşük seviyede slotsuz yaparsın.
tr.wizard:signature-spells: Seçtiğin iki 3. seviye büyü her zaman hazır; kısa dinlenmede birer kez slotsuz.

en.barbarian:rage: You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, a force that grants you extraordinary might and resilience.
en.barbarian:unarmored-defense: While you aren’t wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers.
en.barbarian:weapon-mastery: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice, such as Greataxes and Handaxes.
en.barbarian:danger-sense: You gain an uncanny sense of when things aren’t as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge perils.
en.barbarian:reckless-attack: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with increased ferocity.
en.barbarian:primal-knowledge: You gain proficiency in another skill of your choice from the skill list available to Barbarians at level 1.
en.barbarian:extra-attack: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.barbarian:fast-movement: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren’t wearing Heavy armor.
en.barbarian:feral-instinct: Your instincts are so honed that you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.
en.barbarian:instinctive-pounce: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.
en.barbarian:brutal-strike: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn.
en.barbarian:relentless-rage: Your Rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds.
en.barbarian:improved-brutal-strike: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10.
en.barbarian:persistent-rage: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage.
en.barbarian:indomitable-might: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
en.bard:bardic-inspiration: You can supernaturally inspire others through words, music, or dance.
en.bard:spellcasting: You have learned to cast spells through your bardic arts.
en.bard:expertise: You gain Expertise (see “Rules Glossary”) in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
en.bard:jack-of-all-trades: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn’t otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.
en.bard:font-of-inspiration: You now regain all your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
en.bard:countercharm: You can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects.
en.bard:magical-secrets: You’ve learned secrets from various magical traditions.
en.bard:superior-inspiration: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two if you have fewer than that.
en.bard:words-of-creation: You have mastered two of the Words of Creation: the words of life and death.
en.cleric:spellcasting: You have learned to cast spells through prayer and meditation.
en.cleric:divine-order: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice.
en.cleric:channel-divinity: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes to fuel magical effects.
en.cleric:sear-undead: Whenever you use Turn Undead, you can roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1d8) and add the rolls together.
en.cleric:blessed-strikes: Divine power infuses you in battle.
en.cleric:divine-intervention: You can call on your deity or pantheon to intervene on your behalf.
en.cleric:improved-blessed-strikes: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful.
en.cleric:greater-divine-intervention: You can call on even more powerful divine intervention.
en.druid:spellcasting: You have learned to cast spells through studying the mystical forces of nature.
en.druid:druidic: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids.
en.druid:primal-order: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice.
en.druid:wild-shape: The power of nature allows you to assume the form of an animal.
en.druid:wild-companion: You can summon a nature spirit that assumes an animal form to aid you.
en.druid:wild-resurgence: Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot (no action required).
en.druid:elemental-fury: The might of the elements flows through you.
en.druid:improved-elemental-fury: The option you chose for Elemental Fury grows more powerful, as detailed below.
en.druid:beast-spells: While using Wild Shape, you can cast spells in Beast form, except for any spell that has a Material component with a cost specified or that consumes its Material component.
en.druid:archdruid: The vitality of nature constantly blooms within you, granting you the following benefits.
en.fighter:fighting-style: You have honed your martial prowess and gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see “Feats”).
en.fighter:second-wind: You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on.
en.fighter:weapon-mastery: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice.
en.fighter:action-surge: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment.
en.fighter:tactical-mind: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield.
en.fighter:extra-attack: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.fighter:tactical-shift: Whenever you activate your Second Wind with a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
en.fighter:indomitable: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.
en.fighter:tactical-master: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.
en.fighter:two-extra-attacks: You can attack three times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.fighter:studied-attacks: You study your opponents and learn from each attack you make.
en.fighter:three-extra-attacks: You can attack four times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.monk:martial-arts: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use your Unarmed Strike and Monk weapons, which are the following: • Simple Melee weapons • Martial Melee weapons that have the Light property You gai
en.monk:unarmored-defense: While you aren’t wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.
en.monk:monks-focus: Your focus and martial training allow you to harness a well of extraordinary energy within yourself.
en.monk:unarmored-movement: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren’t wearing armor or wielding a Shield.
en.monk:uncanny-metabolism: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended Focus Points.
en.monk:deflect-attacks: When an attack roll hits you and its damage includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce the attack’s total damage against you.
en.monk:slow-fall: You can take a Reaction when you fall to reduce any damage you take from the fall by an amount equal to five times your Monk level.
en.monk:extra-attack: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.monk:stunning-strike: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a Monk weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 1 Focus Point to attempt a stunning strike.
en.monk:empowered-strikes: Whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.
en.monk:evasion: When you’re subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.
en.monk:acrobatic-movement: While you aren’t wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the movement.
en.monk:heightened-focus: Your Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind gain the following benefits.
en.monk:self-restoration: Through sheer force of will, you can remove one of the following conditions from yourself at the end of each of your turns: Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned.
en.monk:deflect-energy: You can now use your Deflect Attacks feature against attacks that deal any damage type, not just Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing.
en.monk:disciplined-survivor: Your physical and mental discipline grant you proficiency in all saving throws.
en.monk:perfect-focus: When you roll Initiative and don’t use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain expended Focus Points until you have 4 if you have 3 or fewer.
en.monk:superior-defense: At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Focus Points to bolster yourself against harm for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition.
en.monk:body-and-mind: You have developed your body and mind to new heights.
en.paladin:lay-on-hands: Your blessed touch can heal wounds.
en.paladin:spellcasting: You have learned to cast spells through prayer and meditation.
en.paladin:weapon-mastery: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Longswords and Javelins.
en.paladin:fighting-style: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see “Feats” for feats).
en.paladin:paladins-smite: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared.
en.paladin:channel-divinity: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes, using it to fuel magical effects.
en.paladin:extra-attack: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.paladin:faithful-steed: You can call on the aid of an otherworldly steed.
en.paladin:aura-of-protection: You radiate a protective, unseeable aura in a 10-foot Emanation that originates from you.
en.paladin:abjure-foes: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of this class’s Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe.
en.paladin:aura-of-courage: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection.
en.paladin:radiant-strikes: Your strikes now carry supernatural power.
en.paladin:restoring-touch: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned.
en.paladin:aura-expansion: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.
en.ranger:spellcasting: You have learned to channel the magical essence of nature to cast spells.
en.ranger:favored-enemy: You always have the Hunter’s Mark spell prepared.
en.ranger:weapon-mastery: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Longbows and Shortswords.
en.ranger:deft-explorer: Thanks to your travels, you gain the following benefits.
en.ranger:fighting-style: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see “Feats”).
en.ranger:extra-attack: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
en.ranger:roving: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren’t wearing Heavy armor.
en.ranger:expertise: Choose two of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise.
en.ranger:tireless: Primal forces now help fuel you on your journeys, granting you the following benefits.
en.ranger:relentless-hunter: Taking damage can’t break your Concentration on Hunter’s Mark .
en.ranger:natures-veil: You invoke spirits of nature to magically hide yourself.
en.ranger:precise-hunter: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter’s Mark .
en.ranger:feral-senses: Your connection to the forces of nature grants you Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.
en.ranger:foe-slayer: The damage die of your Hunter’s Mark is a d10 rather than a d6.
en.rogue:expertise: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
en.rogue:sneak-attack: You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe’s distraction.
en.rogue:thieves-cant: You picked up various languages in the communities where you plied your roguish talents.
en.rogue:weapon-mastery: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Daggers and Shortbows.
en.rogue:cunning-action: Your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly.
en.rogue:steady-aim: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn.
en.rogue:cunning-strike: You’ve developed cunning ways to use your Sneak Attack.
en.rogue:uncanny-dodge: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack’s damage against you (round down).
en.rogue:evasion: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers.
en.rogue:reliable-talent: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
en.rogue:improved-cunning-strike: You can use up to two Cunning Strike effects when you deal Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each effect.
en.rogue:devious-strikes: You’ve practiced new ways to use your Sneak Attack deviously.
en.rogue:slippery-mind: Your cunning mind is exceptionally difficult to control.
en.rogue:elusive: You’re so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you.
en.rogue:stroke-of-luck: You have a marvelous knack for succeeding when you need to.
en.sorcerer:spellcasting: Drawing from your innate magic, you can cast spells.
en.sorcerer:innate-sorcery: An event in your past left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with simmering magic.
en.sorcerer:font-of-magic: You can tap into the wellspring of magic within yourself.
en.sorcerer:metamagic: Because your magic flows from within, you can alter your spells to suit your needs; you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from “Metamagic Options” later in this class’s description.
en.sorcerer:sorcerous-restoration: When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain expended Sorcery Points, but no more than a number equal to half your Sorcerer level (round down).
en.sorcerer:sorcery-incarnate: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can use it if you spend 2 Sorcery Points when you take the Bonus Action to activate it.
en.sorcerer:arcane-apotheosis: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.
en.warlock:eldritch-invocations: You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons.
en.warlock:pact-magic: Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity to gain magical powers.
en.warlock:magical-cunning: You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute.
en.warlock:contact-patron: In the past, you usually contacted your patron through intermediaries.
en.warlock:mystic-arcanum: Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum.
en.warlock:eldritch-master: When you use your Magical Cunning feature, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.
en.wizard:spellcasting: As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells.
en.wizard:ritual-adept: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook.
en.wizard:arcane-recovery: You can regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook.
en.wizard:scholar: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study.
en.wizard:memorize-spell: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells you have prepared for your Spellcasting feature with another level 1+ spell from the book.
en.wizard:spell-mastery: You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will.
en.wizard:signature-spells: Choose two level 3 spells in your spellbook as your signature spells.

tr.cleave: Yakın dövüş isabetinde ilk hedefin yanındaki, menzilindeki ikinci bir yaratığa da saldırabilirsin; isabette silah hasarı verilir ama yetenek bonusu eklenmez. Turda bir kez.
tr.graze: Saldırı ıskalarsa yine de saldırıda kullandığın yetenek bonusu kadar hasar verirsin (silahın hasar türünde).
tr.nick: Light silahın ek saldırısını bonus eylem yerine Attack eyleminin parçası olarak yaparsın. Turda bir kez.
tr.push: İsabette hedefi senden doğrudan 10 ft itebilirsin (Large ya da daha küçükse).
tr.sap: İsabette hedefin bir sonraki saldırı zarı, senin sonraki turuna kadar dezavantajlı olur.
tr.slow: Hasar verdiğin hedefin hızı senin sonraki turuna kadar 10 ft düşer (toplam düşüş 10 ft'i geçmez).
tr.topple: Hedef CON kurtarma zarı atar, DC = 8 + saldırı yeteneği bonusu + yetkinlik bonusu; başarısızsa Prone olur.
tr.vex: Hasar verdiğin hedefe, sonraki turunun sonuna kadar yapacağın bir sonraki saldırıda avantajın olur.

en.cleave: On a melee hit, you can attack a second creature within 5 ft of the first and within your reach; on a hit it takes the weapon's damage without your ability modifier. Once per turn.
en.graze: If your attack misses, you still deal damage equal to the ability modifier you used for the attack (weapon's damage type).
en.nick: You make the Light weapon's extra attack as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
en.push: On a hit, you can push the target up to 10 ft straight away from you if it is Large or smaller.
en.sap: On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
en.slow: If you deal damage, the target's Speed drops by 10 ft until the start of your next turn (no more than 10 ft in total).
en.topple: The target makes a CON saving throw (DC 8 + attack ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or has the Prone condition.
en.vex: If you deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

tr.finesse: Saldırı ve hasar zarında STR ya da DEX'ten istediğini kullanırsın (ikisinde de aynısı).
tr.light: Hafif silah: Attack eyleminde bununla saldırınca, başka bir Light silahla bonus eylemle ek saldırı yapabilirsin (hasara yetenek bonusu eklenmez).
tr.thrown: Fırlatılarak menzilli saldırı yapılabilir; yakın dövüş silahıysa aynı yeteneği kullanırsın.
tr.versatile: Tek ya da iki elle kullanılır; iki elle daha yüksek hasar zarı.
tr.heavy: Ağır silah: STR (yakın) ya da DEX (menzilli) 13'ün altındaysa saldırıda dezavantaj.
tr.reach: Erişim 5 yerine 10 ft (saldırı ve fırsat saldırısı için).
tr.ammunition: Mühimmatla menzilli saldırı; uzun menzilde dezavantaj.
tr.loading: Bir eylem, bonus eylem ya da tepkide bununla yalnızca bir atış yapılır.

en.finesse: Use your choice of STR or DEX for the attack and damage rolls (the same for both).
en.light: When you attack with it as part of the Attack action, you can make an extra attack as a Bonus Action with a different Light weapon (no ability modifier to damage).
en.thrown: You can throw it to make a ranged attack, using the same ability as for a melee attack with it.
en.versatile: Used with one or two hands; a larger damage die with two hands.
en.heavy: Disadvantage on attacks if your STR (melee) or DEX (ranged) is below 13.
en.twoHanded: Requires two hands when you attack with it.
en.reach: Adds 5 ft to your reach (10 ft) for attacks and opportunity attacks.
en.ammunition: Needs ammunition for ranged attacks; Disadvantage at long range.
en.loading: You can fire only one piece of ammunition per action, Bonus Action or reaction.
